Big Idea fidelity: strategy doc's M2 Big Idea ('Plan mode, done right', mood 'grounded competence') and named teaching moment ('Plan-mode approval inflation catches as the key teaching moment') both land in the file and trace, near-verbatim on the mood line. Module-to-module arc: file's Arc section hands off correctly ('M3 picks up: the judge-building move — the push-backs the student sent at P3 are the raw material for M3's first judge'), matching strategy doc's M3 entry (Earn the trust — Q+S, first authored skill) without duplicating any of M3's skill/security content here. Mood-doesn't-resolve-early: P5 explicitly withholds execution ('Don't execute the plan... Execution is next module's concern'), so M3's earned-trust send-off beat stays unstolen; AE101's mood arc (joy→grounded competence→earned trust→curious readiness→learning through contrast→practitioner fluency) has no M3 'unease' beat to accidentally resolve, and none is resolved here.
